name: factor_shortest
expr: if(frequency == 1, chord_factor_a, if(frequency == 2, min(chord_factor_a, chord_factor_b), min(chord_factor_a, min(chord_factor_b, chord_factor_c))))

name: v3_n02_r
expr: sqrt((cu0_x + cu1_x + cl0_x)^2 + (cu0_y + cu1_y + cl0_y)^2 + (cu0_z + cu1_z + cl0_z)^2)

name: v3_n03_r
expr: sqrt((cl0_x + cl4_x + cu0_x)^2 + (cl0_y + cl4_y + cu0_y)^2 + (cl0_z + cl4_z + cu0_z)^2)

name: v3_n05_r
expr: sqrt((ct_x + cu0_x + cu1_x)^2 + (ct_y + cu0_y + cu1_y)^2 + (ct_z + cu0_z + cu1_z)^2)

name: radius
expr: if(size_by == 1, radius_input, sqrt(floor_area / pi) * 1000 mm / base_rho)

name: bolt_order_length
expr: ceil((strut_thick + 2 * washer_t + nut_height + 2 * thread_pitch) / 10 mm) * 10 mm

name: strut_end_needed
expr: (tube_radius + hub_gap) / cos(asin(factor_shortest / 2)) + cheek_setback + a3_end + a1_spacing + fin_end_margin + 10 mm

name: radius_min_formula
expr: max(1500 mm, max(2 * (strut_end_needed + spare_half) / factor_shortest, stubby_ratio_limit * strut_depth / factor_shortest))

name: radius_max_formula
expr: min(stock_length / factor_longest, min(slenderness_limit * strut_thick / (sqrt(12) * factor_longest), 8000 mm))

name: post_d1_1_h
expr: radius * v1_n02_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v1_n02_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v1_n02_z) / sqrt(1 - v1_n02_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

name: post_d2_1_h
expr: radius * v2_n03_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v2_n03_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v2_n03_z) / sqrt(1 - v2_n03_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

name: post_d3_1_h
expr: radius * v3_n02_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v3_n02_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v3_n02_z) / sqrt(1 - v3_n02_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

name: post_d3_2_h
expr: radius * v3_n01_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v3_n01_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v3_n01_z) / sqrt(1 - v3_n01_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

name: post_d4_1_h
expr: radius * v3_n00_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v3_n00_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v3_n00_z) / sqrt(1 - v3_n00_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

name: post_d4_2_h
expr: radius * v3_n03_z + dome_lift - tube_radius / sqrt(1 - v3_n03_z^2) - post_radius * abs(v3_n03_z) / sqrt(1 - v3_n03_z^2) - 1 mm - ring_height - plate_thickness

dome_type
label: Frequency and truncation
description: How finely the sphere is divided (1V, 2V or 3V) and how much of it stands: the number of struts and hubs follows.

name: size_by
label: Size given by
description: Give the dome's radius, or the floor area you need.

name: radius_input

description: Radius of the sphere through the hub centres. Used when the dome is sized by radius.

name: floor_area
label: Floor area (m2)
description: Floor area inside the base ring, in square metres. Used when the dome is sized by floor area.

name: strut_section
label: Strut section
description: Sawn timber, thickness by depth, standing on edge. Thickness limits the length of the struts, so a thicker strut allows a larger dome.

name: plate_thickness
label: Hub plate thickness
description: Thickness of the laser-cut steel fin and cap plates. The saw kerf in the strut follows, 2 mm wider.

name: laser_kerf
label: Laser kerf
description: The fin plate holes are drawn this much smaller, so they come out at size after the beam has burnt the kerf away.

name: ring_height
label: Base ring height
description: Height of the low ring wall the dome stands on.

name: show_person
label: Show a person for scale
description: A 1.75 m figure beside the dome, for scale only; it is not part of the cut sheet.

title: Geodesic timber dome
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A geodesic timber-strut dome with laser-cut steel hubs. Pick a frequency and truncation (1V, 2V or 3V, with the published chord factors of a table), give a radius or a floor area, and read off the strut schedule, the timber to buy and the hub count. To export: File > Export, sheet of set Hub plates to laser cut, as DXF or SVG for the laser (one of each part; the outputs say how many to cut); and the set Strut templates for the bolt holes and end cuts of each strut type.
